text: Part four. The city runs on sun. It's *gone*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day one of clouds. The green city feels *sleepy*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day two. People yawn in the middle of *sentences*.

speaker: friendLeaf
text: I'm so tired. Jay, is it *Tuesday*?

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Mia. It's *Saturday*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day three. A new shop opens. *Sun Minutes*.

speaker: dealer
text: One minute under my lamp. *Ten dollars*.

speaker: narrator
text: The line is longer than Rosa's ever was. *Ever*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Your hundred and five dollars? *Gone*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: I just need one more hour of *light*.

speaker: narrator
text: Day four. Jay forgets his own *phone number*.

speaker: narrator
text: He sits on the curb. He can't *stand up*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay, eat something. Real food. *Please*.

speaker: heroLeaf
text: Food costs money, Bit. I have *nothing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Bit's battery icon flashes *red*.

speaker: bit
text: Funny. I run on sunlight too. And I'm *low*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay looks at his hands. They're turning *gray*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Bit... is this *permanent*?

speaker: bit
text: Four percent. Jay, *listen to me*...

speaker: narrator
text: Part five drops in two days.
